about_the_game:
"Fingertips Asking the Way" is a strategy match-3 game with the theme of cultivation. It simulates the experience of a cultivator, from a rookie to a cultivator who has gone through many setbacks and finally achieved perfection and ascended to heaven.

The world is a plate, and the affairs of the world are like children. In this small space, the choices and encounters of the cultivators in each round reflect the hardships and impermanence of the path of cultivation.

The monk needs to collect Yuanshi, absorb essence, and try his best to prolong his life in this world

If the monk wants to better control the spell, he needs to breathe in the spiritual energy and internalize the spiritual power

Once you enter this world, you will bear the cause and effect of this world

Sometimes, demons and monsters wreak havoc on the world, and monks are needed to enforce justice, control swordsmanship, and slay demons and monsters

Sometimes, the practice of a cultivator causes strange phenomena in heaven and earth, and thunder strikes. The cultivator needs to resolve it in time, otherwise it will bring disaster to one side and damage his Tao heart.

When traveling in the mortal world, it is inevitable to have intersections with others, or sit and discuss, or different paths compete with each other, in between, this story will be presented sentence by sentence

No matter what the choice is, the monk will get the opportunity to improve his own cultivation

Break through the realm, and the monk can obtain more resources and skill strategies. There are a total of 10 active skills and 40 strategies. Each construction tendency will bring a different practice experience.

As time goes by and the realm is improved, the monk also moves from a remote corner of the world to the center of the stage. The world situation moves because of you

But no matter how wonderful this life is, the world will not tolerate those who steal lives. Unless you jump out of the Three Realms and Five Elements, you will still need reincarnation even if you can call the wind and rain;

Even if you just extend your lifespan, the cultivator can feel that the loss of essence is gradually accelerating with time, and the test of heaven on the cultivator will also deepen in stages.

When the trend of reincarnation is complete, the heavenly calamity will come violently. If the cultivator can withstand this calamity, he will have the qualifications to jump out of reincarnation and ascend to heaven.

Throughout the thousands of reincarnations, the monks gradually developed ways to deal with them.

During the training of a lifetime, the monks can consume a large amount of spiritual power to arrange the blessed land formation in advance to resist the disaster.

There are a total of 10 kinds of blessed lands, all of which have powerful effects, such as killing enemies or generating resources out of thin air. These blessed lands will have a key impact on the monks' practice.

During reincarnation, the monks built narrow caves for themselves, dissipated the accumulated willpower of a lifetime, sacrificed magic weapons, and cleansed their orifices. After reincarnation, there are more possibilities for practice in the next life.

In the next life, a different starting point, a different life, a different fate, and a different practice experience.

Procedurally randomly generated resources and challenges, free construction and building, provide more than 20 hours of freshness in the game
